_note: Hand-written cook builds. build_data.py adds augment text, China win rates and simulator numbers and writes data.js. The first `core` augments decide the build's tier; the rest are flex picks. `augment_text` replaces the generated text for augments whose tooltip numbers the game data doesn't fill in.

augment_text.With Haste: Gain Move Speed equal to a share of your Ability Haste.

builds.title: Death Is the Plan
builds.why: Karthus already keeps casting after he dies. Here every death also sets off a true-damage explosion worth 20% of each nearby enemy's max Health, drops a Tibbers that stuns and chases your killer, and fires a Clown College fear burst. Then the passive lets you keep casting through all of it.
builds.play: Walk into the middle of their team, press R, and die on purpose. Glass Cannon makes the dying part faster. Don't buy Zhonya's: that would be cheating.

builds.title: One Button Malphite
builds.why: Ult Bot sends all your Ability Haste to R at 1.5x strength, Ultimate Revolution gives you a second R right after the first, and Stuck In Here With Me adds more Ult Haste and taunts everyone you landed on. Fey Magic then turns them into critters. Q, W and E are decorative.
builds.play: Buy every Ability Haste item you can, since it all goes to R. Ult in, ult again, get taunted at, repeat.

builds.title: Microscopic Menace
builds.why: Giant Slayer makes Teemo tiny and adds 10 to 30% damage against anything bigger than him, which is everything. Each Shrink Engine takedown shrinks him another 4% and adds 8 Ability Haste, and Combusting Interest pays him gold for every tick of poison. Late game you are mostly a voice line.
builds.play: Shroom every bush, poison everyone, and enjoy being hard to click.

builds.title: Melee Sheriff
builds.why: The longest-ranged marksman in the game throws her rifle away for a sword. Draw Your Sword's AD, Health, Attack Speed, Lifesteal and Move Speed all grow with the range you lost, so Caitlyn gets one of the biggest versions of it. It is also the highest win-rate Prismatic augment in China.
builds.play: Walk up and hit people. Headshots still work at point-blank range.

builds.title: Healing Hurts
builds.why: Mundo's whole kit is Health regen, and Circle of Death turns 70% of every point of healing and regen into magic damage at the nearest enemy. With Warmog's, Spirit Visage and his R, standing around regenerating is now a damage combo.
builds.play: Press R and stand next to someone. Perseverance (more regen) is the flex pick; it has no China stats yet.

builds.title: Kaiju
builds.why: Feast, Goliath, Tank Engine and Growth Spurt all make you bigger, and Growth Spurt is a summoner spell whose whole job is to grow and knock everyone up. Steel Your Heart triples your Heartsteel stacks once you reach 300. You will block the camera.
builds.play: Feast on everything. The Heartsteel calculator in Fun Tools shows how big the stacks get.

builds.title: Speed Demon
builds.why: Don't Blink adds 1% damage per 10 Move Speed you have over your target, and Hecarim's passive already turns bonus Move Speed into AD. Leg Day adds a flat 50 Move Speed and With Haste turns Ability Haste into more. Every source of speed is now damage, twice.
builds.play: Never stop running. Pick a target slower than you, which is all of them.

builds.title: All In on Red
builds.why: You never pick an augment yourself. Every slot is a random roll, and Pandora's Box at the end rerolls all of them into random Prismatics. Ashe is on China's best-champion list for all four, so the casino is somehow on your side.
builds.play: Take every Transmute you see. Narrate your rolls to your team.

builds.title: King of the Bridge
builds.why: King Me has the lowest win rate of any augment in China at about 33%. To trigger it you ride the enemy team's transport while holding a Legendary item, and only then do you get Kinged with an upgraded item and a free Prismatic. The other three are pure gold, because a pirate king needs a treasury.
builds.play: Rush a Legendary, find their transport, and become royalty. Then probably lose.

builds.title: Clown Fiesta
builds.why: Clown College teaches Shaco Deceive and Backstab, which he already knows, as a second Deceive summoner spell. Minionmancer makes his boxes and clone 40% bigger and stronger, and when he dies he leaves a fear burst, a true-damage explosion and a Tibbers behind.
builds.play: Box every bush, Deceive twice, and make your death everyone else's problem.

builds.title: Minion Union
builds.why: Voidlings come out 40% bigger and stronger, Hand of Baron turns every allied minion near you into a Baron minion, and you get 25% Adaptive Force for the trouble. You are no longer a mage, you are a labor movement.
builds.play: Stay with the wave and let the army do it.

builds.title: Fairy Tea Party
builds.why: Every augment triggers on R. Death Lotus turns everyone it hits into a critter for 2 seconds, Can't Touch This makes you invulnerable for 2, Ultimate Unstoppable makes you immune to crowd control for 3, and Final Form adds a max-Health shield, Omnivamp and Move Speed. Nobody can interrupt the spin because nobody has hands.
builds.play: Shunpo in, R, and spin until the critters are gone. Katarina is in the top champions for all four.

builds.title: Snowball Main
builds.why: Four augments, all for Mark/Dash. The snowball is huge and passes through minions, bounces off walls and grows with each bounce, knocks everyone up on the recast, and makes you invulnerable while you fly in. Tahm Kench is near the top for nearly every snowball augment.
builds.play: Your real ability bar is one summoner spell. Bank shots off the walls.

builds.title: Trundle Theme Park
builds.why: Trundle is on China's best-champion list for all four. Feed Poros until you unlock a Poro Charge summoner spell, swing around your own pillar on a grappling hook, make the pillar burn everyone near it, and collect shields from teammates patting you on the back.
builds.play: Feed the Poros first. Poro Stampede is one of the least-picked augments in the mode for a reason.

builds.title: Strict Vampire
builds.why: Vampirism bans healing from allies and Health regen in exchange for 25% Omnivamp, and Ominous Pact adds 20% more Omnivamp, 50% Move Speed and Ability Power the lower your Health gets, while every cast costs 5% of your current Health. Goredrink and Warlock Juicebox stack even more Omnivamp on top. You only eat what you kill.
builds.play: Stay low, stay fast, and tell your Soraka to heal someone else. Vampirism has no China stats yet.

builds.title: Violent Pacifist
builds.why: Every heal is an attack. Circle of Death sends 70% of your healing as magic damage at the nearest enemy, Sonic Boom deals true damage and slows around whoever you heal, and Spirit Bomb throws a heal-and-shield bomb at your lowest teammate. Wee Woo Wee Woo makes you faster toward hurt allies.
builds.play: Heal everyone. Watch the kill feed.

builds.title: Flash Mob
builds.why: Every Flash augment at once. Flashy gives Flash 3 charges, Flash 2 adds a second Flash spell with 70 Summoner Haste, and Flashbang makes each one explode and slow. That is four Flashes on call for Insec kicks, and Earthwake leaves a detonating trail behind every Q and W dash in between.
builds.play: Ward-hop, Flash, kick, Flash, Flash. Nobody will know where you are, including you.

builds.title: Beyblade Garen
builds.why: Spin To Win makes Judgment bigger, faster and more often. If Echo Cast and Quickstep roll on E, Judgment also sends a spinning clone and dashes you toward your cursor every time you press it. Blade Waltz adds a summoner spell that dashes through enemies eight times. Garen in China is on the best-champion list for all four.
builds.play: Hope Echo Cast and Quickstep land on E, then hold the spin and steer with your mouse.

builds.title: Prom King
builds.why: Every 35 seconds a tiara drops on Singed and he gets Rakan's ultimate, charming everyone he runs past. Leg Day adds 50 Move Speed and Slow Resist, Escape Plan gives a giant shield and 150% Move Speed when he drops low, and every teammate he jogs past pats him for a shield and more speed. Singed is on China's best-champion list for all four.
builds.play: Run past your team to collect pats, then run through theirs in your tiara. Leave poison everywhere.

builds.title: Autopilot
builds.why: All four augments fire on their own. A boomerang flies out every 7 seconds, three fox flames orbit and shoot the closest enemy, Hextech Soul chains lightning off your next hit, and Quantum Computing swings a giant slash around you every 30 seconds. Twisted Fate is the top China champion for Ok Boomerang.
builds.play: Pick a card and let the augments play the rest. Quantum Computing has no China stats yet.

builds.title: Time Loop
builds.why: Ult Bot sends all Ability Haste to R at 1.5x, Recursion's 60 haste and every haste item go there too, and Ultimate Revolution gives a second Chronoshift right after the first. Your team gets two revives on a short cooldown. Archmage keeps Q and W refunding each other since they get no haste of their own.
builds.play: Chronoshift whoever is about to die, then the next person. Save nothing.

builds.title: Mana Tank
builds.why: Mind to Matter gives Health equal to half your Mana, and Overflow doubles your Mana costs but makes your damage scale with max Mana. Stack Muramana, Seraph's, Rod of Ages and Frozen Heart and Ezreal turns into a frontline that throws Mystic Shots. Ezreal is on China's best list for both mana augments and Upgrade Sheen.
builds.play: Q everything, Spellblade everything, and stand closer than an Ezreal should.

builds.title: Heavy Metal
builds.why: Sona as a giant tank. Goliath and Tank Engine stack size and Health, Heavy Hitter makes every Power Chord hit for a share of that Health, and Sonata plays her heal and speed songs automatically every 10 seconds, so she never has to press W or E.
builds.play: Walk up, Q, auto. The band plays itself.

builds.title: Net Zero
builds.why: Every augment cancels another one. Goliath makes you big and Giant Slayer makes you tiny. Celestial Body adds 1,500 Health and cuts your damage 10%, and Glass Cannon cuts 30% of your Health for extra true damage. Miss Fortune is on China's list for Giant Slayer and Glass Cannon, which is the only reason she was picked.
builds.play: Play normal Miss Fortune. Nobody will be able to tell what changed.

builds.title: Marksman Karma
builds.why: The simulator's biggest surprise. Searching every item for every champion, its best Karma build was a full crit marksman build, at 2.4x the damage of its best mage build and with better survival. The simulator doesn't model enchanter shields or Mantra, so take it with salt, but these are the simulator's own augment picks.
builds.play: Buy Berserker's and right-click. RQ to Mantra your own damage if you remember.

builds.title: Glass Scorpion
builds.why: Another simulator find: a full lethality Skarner did 1.36x the damage of its best tank build. The catch is he survived a third of fights instead of more than half, so the tank gets deleted after grabbing someone.
builds.play: R the carry into your team and hope your team is there.

builds.title: Bonk Taric
builds.why: The simulator's best Taric is half tank and half on-hit: Dual Wield and Deft make him swing fast, and Heavy Hitter and Titanic Hydra make every swing hit for a share of his Heartsteel Health. It beat his best normal build by about a quarter in damage with the same survival.
builds.play: Stun, then bonk. Bravado keeps the empowered bonks coming.
